authority: Accepted ADR-EVI-0007 and express full internal v2.8.0 authorization; preserves owner-protocol-v3.json and owner-intake-checkpoint.json intent_authority_matrix.
purpose: Compose existing seven-record codec and clock checks into the authenticated approval/grant/intent/completion/lease graph required by the fixed native Owner and phase host. Data eligibility never issues authority or performs an effect.
preserved: Existing Owner schema/codec/clock and every historical test remain unchanged
No root export, registry, capability, policy, filesystem, SQLite, process, public output or release effect in this component
Native host must acquire admission, supply its own actual namespace/clock/scope observations, revalidate outputs/durability and obtain fresh ordinary authority

api.readReconciliationOwnerState: (input: unknown) => deeply frozen safe ReconciliationOwnerState; exact input fields issuer_bytes, approval_bytes, grant_bytes, intent_bytes, completion_bytes, lease_bytes. issuer/approval are canonical actual Uint8Array records; arrays of canonical actual Uint8Array records; lease null or bytes. No callbacks/providers/path inputs. Verify issuer self MAC and every other MAC with its canonical key, then validate the complete graph. No private key/bytes/MAC or original record escapes.
api.assessReconciliationOwnerPhase: (state: unknown, phase: unknown, observedClock: unknown, outputs: unknown) => exact safe assessment; accepts ONLY a module-private WeakMap-branded state produced by readReconciliationOwnerState. phase01..04; outputs absent|partial-known|complete|unknown. Clock is validated data, never a trusted clock origin. Return phase, grant_status live|expired|revoked, disposition start|resume|settle|completed|held, intent_sha256, completion_sha256, grants_authority:false. Invalid graph/clock/phase throws closed safe code. Unknown output ->held. Partial without prior intent ->held. Completed phase returns same completion after clock validity checks without accepting new output claims as evidence.
api.error: ReconciliationOwnerStateError with fixed name and code/message RECONCILIATION_OWNER_STATE_INVALID; no cause, raw values or nested errors.

bounds.ingress: Descriptor-safe exact plain/null object; ordinary/null dense array with enumerable data indices and intrinsic length only; no Proxy, symbols, getters, holes, overridden iterators/species. Copy byte views via intrinsic semantics as existing codec; reject shared/detached. Enforce aggregate bound before decoding. Never retain supplied mutable bytes.

graph: Issuer kind issuer; approval kind approval. Exact whole canonical JCS+LF byte SHA for every reference. Approval issuer_sha256 equals issuer bytes SHA; repository/worktree match issuer and scope.host_identity_sha256 equals issuer.host_identity_sha256. Approval scope digest already codec-checked. Fresh approval may occur after issuer installation boot/HEAD; installation observations do not freeze future current bindings.

Every linked record exactly matches approval_id, issuer_sha256, original approval_sha256, scope_sha256 and repository/worktree. Grant input order is sequence order: approval sequence1 then exact contiguous grant sequence2..N; exact previous raw digest. No fork, duplicate, gap or grant following terminal revocation. Grant clocks share approval boot/source and are nondecreasing in both wall/ns with <=2000ms elapsed disagreement; expiry itself does not invalidate immutable history.

Intent/completion arrays may be phase ordered or arbitrary input order; unique phase required. Each intent grant names approval or a prior renewal, never revocation; signed issue is within that grant exact declared wall/ns deadlines and fixed maximum. Its phase is permitted by that grant. Approval allows01..04; renewal permits its exact remaining_phases. At most one uncompleted intent and no phase gap. An intent for phaseN requires exactly phaseN-1 completion digest (null only01). Intent timestamp cannot precede that completion or its referenced grant.

Each completion names exact same-phase intent and exact predecessor completion; observed_grant_sha256 identifies a known grant event that may be revoked or expired. Completion clock cannot precede intent, referenced observed grant or predecessor. Completion authenticity is graph evidence only; durable literal and manifest hashes do not prove actual output or fsync.

Each renewal remaining_phases equals all phases not completed as of its signed issue, including at most one existing uncompleted intent. resumable_intent_sha256 names exactly that intent or is null if none. Simultaneous-clock ambiguity is resolved conservatively by immutable reference/order and must not infer that a record existed merely from a tied timestamp. Review must resolve an exact deterministic ordering before implementation if available fields cannot support this.

Lease, if present, names an existing uncompleted intent, exact phase/action/initiator and original_intent_sha256. Host identity equals original approval scope. Its grant is known and nonrevocation, its clock not before intent/grant. A retry lease may name same-scope renewal only if that renewal explicitly names original intent. Lease nonce/invocation need not equal original intent for owned retry. Graph cannot prove PID liveness, actual host or lease ownership; native host must do so.
eligibility: Validate current observation against current grant clock and latest signed history observation: same boot/source, no rollback or >2000ms elapsed disagreement. Revocation remains terminal, expiry means observation >= either exact declared deadline; use BigInt ns. The maximum clock window remains900000ms even when smaller signed validity applies.

Live unstarted next phase with absent outputs ->start. Live exact existing intent with absent/partial-known ->resume only if current grant is its original grant or current renewal explicitly names it. Live complete existing intent ->settle. Any unknown/foreign/changed/indeterminate output classification ->held.

Expired/revoked absent/partial-known ->held; complete exact existing intent ->settle only. Renewal cannot revive revoked scope; a live renewal can resume only its named original intent and start allowed remaining phases. Completed returns original completion; no duplicate consumption. Future phase before predecessor completion ->held.
All ten retained intent matrix rows require independent explicit cases. Returned dispositions are eligibility data for fixed native host, never authorization, output attestation or a callable effect.
